title.zh: 查询直播语音审核配置

descriptions.zh:
- 先获取主播流域名，调用本接口查询直播语音审核配置。

- 目前仅部分直播中心支持直播智能审核，具体支持该功能的直播中心，请参见[服务地域](~~193730~~)。

## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this API operation to query the audio moderation configurations for a specific streaming domain.

- Automated review is supported only in some live centers. For supported regions, see [Service regions](~~193730~~).

## QPS limit

You can call this operation up to 10 times per second per account. Requests that exceed this limit are dropped and you may experience service interruptions.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-audio-audit-config --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name liveApp0000 --stream-name liveStream0000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun live DescribeLiveAudioAuditConfig --region cn-hangzhou --StreamName liveStream0000 --DomainName 'example.com' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --AppName liveApp0000
